name: agent_fanout
description: Two independent jobs become two agents started in one batch, each with a brief, whose answers come back to the call.
prompt: Two independent jobs: add an 'Install' section to README.md, and add a 0.2.0 entry to CHANGELOG.md. Delegate them so they run in parallel, then tell me what you started.

arguments.brief:
README install section
Add an Install section to README.md. Done when: README.md has an Install section.

CHANGELOG 0.2.0
Add a 0.2.0 entry to CHANGELOG.md. Done when: CHANGELOG.md lists 0.2.0.

respond.content: Both agents finished: README install section and CHANGELOG 0.2.0.
